column1: # configs/models.tsv — the evaluation registry (one row = one evaluation run).
# Running, scoring and summarizing all read this file; add a row to evaluate a new model.
#   name      run name (prefix of the output directory; variants such as reasoning effort get their own name)
#   model     Hugging Face repo id or a local checkpoint directory
#   profile   key in src/model_profiles.py      mode  think / nothink      tp  tensor-parallel size
#   sampling  auto (official values if the profile marks them as recommended, otherwise greedy) / greedy / official
#   category subgroup family   labels used in tables        total_B active_B   parameters (billions)
